name: Studio66 Refund Helper for WooCommerce
author: studio66 amsterdam

sections.description:
Studio66 Refund Helper for WooCommerce adds a small calculator to every WooCommerce order edit page. When you click the Refund button, the calculator appears and lets you fill in a percentage or fixed amount. With one click it fills in all the refund fields proportionally — no more manual arithmetic per line.

Features

  • Appears automatically when the Refund panel is opened — no configuration needed
  • Percentage mode — applies a percentage to every refundable order line
  • Fixed amount mode — distributes a fixed amount proportionally across all lines; rounding remainder goes to the last line
  • Clear button resets all refund fields to zero in one click
  • Respects the WooCommerce decimal separator (comma or period)
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible
  • Compatible with Loco Translate — Dutch (nl_NL) translation included
  • No account, no license key, no sign-up required
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it directly via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any order in WooCommerce → Orders, click the Refund button, and the calculator appears automatically.

No settings page is required. The plugin works immediately after activation.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an account or license key?

No. All features work immediately after activation — no account, no sign-up, no license key needed.

Where does the calculator appear?

It appears on the order edit page inside the WooCommerce admin, just above the order totals, as soon as you click the Refund button. It is hidden when the refund panel is closed.

Does it work with HPOS?

Yes. The plugin hooks into the WooCommerce order admin footer and explicitly declares HPOS compatibility via WooCommerce’s FeaturesUtil.

Can I translate the plugin into my language?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with Loco Translate. Install Loco Translate, navigate to Loco Translate → Plugins → Studio66 Refund Helper for WooCommerce, and add your language. Dutch (nl_NL) is already included.

Which WooCommerce versions are supported?

WooCommerce 7.0 and higher. Tested up to WooCommerce 9.9.
